title: Plural partitive demonstratives
focus: With a plural partitive noun, use näitä for nearby “these”, noita for farther “those”, and niitä for “them/those” already mentioned: Etsin näitä kirjoja. — I am looking for these books. These forms can also stand alone.

exercises.prompt: Nearby.Complete “I am looking for these books.” Etsin ____ kirjoja.
exercises.explanation: Use näitä for these nearby things, noita for those farther away, and niitä for them or those already mentioned, in the partitive pattern. The standard written partitive form of nämä is näitä; learn this pronoun form directly.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural partitive demonstratives: form or use confused

optionFeedback.näitä: Use näitä for these nearby things, noita for those farther away, and niitä for them or those already mentioned, in the partitive pattern. The standard written partitive form of nämä is näitä; learn this pronoun form directly.
optionFeedback.noita: noita indicates several farther references. The visible cue instead requires näitä: several nearby references.
optionFeedback.niitä: niitä indicates several already-mentioned references. The visible cue instead requires näitä: several nearby references.

sentenceExplanation.translation: I am looking for these books.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: verb + partitive demonstrative agreeing with the following noun + plural partitive noun used as the object of the action

parts.role: verb
parts.formation: etsin comes from etsiä: etsi- + -n.

parts.role: partitive demonstrative agreeing with the following noun
parts.formation: The standard written partitive form of nämä is näitä; learn this pronoun form directly.

parts.role: plural partitive noun used as the object of the action
parts.formation: Replace final a with o, then add -ja: kirjo- + -ja = kirjoja.
